title: Dirt Items
description: In our Dirt Items mode, there are dirt items such as dirt pickaxe, sword, axe, shovel, hoe, helmet, chest armor, boots.
body:
# POWER OF THE DUSTY WORLD: EARTH ARMOR AND ITEM MOD
EARTH ARMOR MOD ADDS A BRAND NEW AND UNIQUE TOUCH TO YOUR Minecraft world! With this mod, EARTH INSPIRED ARMORS and POWERFUL ITEMS are included in your game. The durability and power that come from nature itself make you ready for new adventures.

**HIGHLIGHTED FEATURES OF THE MOD:**
EARTH ARMOR: Durable and natural looking armor set. It both increases your defense and offers a style integrated with nature. Unique with its soft earth tones and solid structure.

**NEW ITEMS**: New weapons and vehicles with earth theme. It allows you to use resources more effectively in the game and also looks great as a decoration.

**EASY TO USE**: The mod is fully compatible with the current Minecraft version and works flawlessly. Crafting recipes are presented to players in a simple and understandable way.

**PERFORMANCE-FRIENDLY**: Provides a smooth experience without tiring your game. It is ready to be published on the Modrinth platform as stable and optimized.

### WHY SHOULD YOU CHOOSE THE EARTH ARMOR MOD?
It is specially designed for adventurous players who want to carry the power of nature to their armor. With this mod that is not only powerful but also adds a different atmosphere to the game in terms of aesthetics, your exploration and battles will become much more exciting.

SPECIAL FOR MODRINTH: This mod is completely original, open source and constantly updated in line with community demands. Download and experience the mod, support with your comments!

FOR MORE INFORMATION AND UPDATES:

Follow the Modrinth page.

We are waiting for your feedback.

New versions soon
